newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Mannan loading 14,000 tonnes sugar using big bags. Kallang loading 14,000 tonnes using big bags. Robin loading 16,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, seven vessels to load sugar.
Road: 191 trucks carrying sugar arrived on July 17.
Loading (July 17): 2,478 tonnes using big bags, 3,429 tonnes bulk.

Vessels: Tai Pan, Manley Exeter, Jurata and George B. each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Mattz Spica loading 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Mariner II loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load bulk sugar and five to load sugar (unspecified). At Cargill private terminal, Ya Jaleel loading 30,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load sugar (unspecified).
Stocks: 13,655 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
